description: Resend the email-verification message to the bound team's owner. The response never reveals the owner's email address. A `200` with `status: SENT` is returned only when an email was sent. Returns `400` if the email is already verified and `429` if one was sent too recently. Requires `GROWSURF_API_KEY`; does not require `GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID`.
name: growsurf_resend_team_owner_verification_email

status.description: Status of the verification email request.

success.description: Whether the verification email request was accepted.

title: Resend Team Owner Verification Email
